# Exercise 1

Using pandas and `flights.parquet`:


```{python}
flights = pd.read_parquet("../data/flights.parquet")
```

1. How many flights to LAX did each legacy carrier (AA, UA, DL, US) have in May from JFK, and what was their mean actual air time?

   ```{python}
   (flights
     .query("dest == 'LAX' and origin == 'JFK' and month == 5 and carrier in ['AA', 'UA', 'DL', 'US']")
     .groupby("carrier", as_index=False)
     .agg(
       n = ("flight", "size"),
       avg_air_time = ("air_time", "mean")
     )
   )
   ```


2. Which plane has the most flight records from each New York airport (no missing tail numbers, all ties)?

   ```{python}
   (flights
     .dropna(subset=["tailnum"])
     .groupby(["origin", "tailnum"])
     .size()
     .groupby("origin", group_keys=False)
     .nlargest(1, keep="all")
     .reset_index(name="n")
   )
   ```

3. Which five calendar dates had the lowest mean departure delay (ties broken by earliest date)?

   ```{python}
   (flights
     .groupby(["year", "month", "day"], as_index=False)
     .agg(avg_dep_delay = ("dep_delay", "mean"))
     .dropna(subset=["avg_dep_delay"])
     .sort_values(["avg_dep_delay", "year", "month", "day"])
     .head(5)
   )
   ```

4. Which flight has the largest arrival delay as a percentage of its actual air time (no missing values or nonpositive air times, all ties)?

   ```{python}
   (flights
     .dropna(subset=["arr_delay"])
     .query("air_time > 0")
     .assign(arr_delay_pct = 100 * pd.col("arr_delay") / pd.col("air_time"))
     .nlargest(1, "arr_delay_pct", keep="all")
     [["month", "day", "carrier", "flight", "origin", "dest", "arr_delay", "air_time", "arr_delay_pct"]]
   )
   ```
